itens.titulo: Brown Advisory Sees AI Infrastructure Opportunity in Lumentum Holdings Inc. (LITE)
itens.descricao: Brown Advisory Sees AI Infrastructure Opportunity in Lumentum Holdings Inc. (LITE) Yahoo Finance
trechos: Brown Advisory, an investment management company, released its "Mid-Cap Growth Strategy" Q3 2026 investor letter.

The strategy outperformed its benchmark in the third quarter of 2026, as sharp market volatility and a reversal in investor sentiment toward artificial intelligence infrastructure created opportunities for active stock selection.
The Strategy returned -2.7% net of fees, compared with a 5.8% decline in the Russell Midcap Growth Index, while its year-to-date net return reached 4.0%, versus a 1.0% gain for the benchmark.
Industrials became the portfolio's largest overweight, while Information Technology rose to approximately 34% of assets.
In addition, please check the Fund's top five holdings to know its best picks in 2026.
In its third-quarter 2026 investor letter, Brown Advisory Mid-Cap Growth Strategy highlighted Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:LITE).
The strategy's investment case centered on demand for high-speed optical components, including 1.6-terabit modules and optical circuit switching.
The one-month return of Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:LITE) was 822.51%, while its shares traded between $157.40 and $1,143.00 over the last 52 weeks.

itens.titulo: TSLA Q3 Earnings Beat on Auto Margin Gains, '26 Capex View Cut
itens.descricao: TSLA Q3 Earnings Beat on Auto Margin Gains, '26 Capex View Cut Yahoo Finance
trechos: Tesla TSLA reported third-quarter 2026 adjusted earnings of 48 cents per share, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of 45 cents by 6.67%.
However, earnings declined 4% from 50 cents in the year-ago quarter, reflecting higher operating expenses.
Revenues totaled $28.05 billion, down marginally from $28.1 billion a year ago.
Revenues surpassed the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $27.78 billion by 0.96%.

Tesla, Inc. Price, Consensus and EPS Surprise Tesla, Inc. price-consensus-eps-surprise-chart | Tesla, Inc. Quote Vehicle Deliveries Fall Despite Strong Demand Tesla produced 464,391 vehicles during the quarter, up 4% year over year.
Model 3/Y production increased 5% to 457,387 units, while production of other models declined 40% to 7,004 units.
Vehicle deliveries declined 2% year over year to 486,532 units.
Model 3/Y deliveries slipped 1% to 478,237 units, while other model deliveries plunged 48% to 8,295 units.

itens.descricao: Seeking Clues to Coca-Cola (KO) Q3 Earnings? A Peek Into Wall Street Projections for Key Metrics Yahoo Finance
trechos: Analysts on Wall Street project that Coca-Cola (KO) will announce quarterly earnings of $0.87 per share in its forthcoming report, representing an increase of 6.1% year over year.
Revenues are projected to reach $12.93 billion, increasing 4.1% from the same quarter last year.
The consensus EPS estimate for the quarter has remained unchanged over the last 30 days.
The consensus estimate for 'Net Operating Revenues- North America' stands at $5.47 billion.
The estimate points to a change of +4.1% from the year-ago quarter.
The collective assessment of analysts points to an estimated 'Net Operating Revenues- Latin America' of $1.73 billion.
The estimate indicates a year-over-year change of +9.7%.
Based on the collective assessment of analysts, 'Net Operating Revenues- Asia Pacific' should arrive at $1.46 billion.

itens.titulo: DeFi tokens lead crypto lower as bitcoin (BTC) price gives up Wednesday’s surge
itens.descricao: DeFi tokens lead crypto lower as bitcoin (BTC) price gives up Wednesday’s surge CoinDesk
trechos: Bitcoin slides below $82,000 as AI doubts return, with DeFi tokens leading declines Bitcoin as much as 2.9% to around $81,600 as Nasdaq futures dropped, while the CoinDesk 80 lost 3.5% and DeFi index slid 6%.
- Bitcoin fell to around $81,800, down 2.7% since midnight UTC, extending its decline below $82,500 after a late-Wednesday surge to nearly $84,800 reversed.
- Mixed results from Tesla and Meta revived doubts over AI spending, weighing on equities and sending Nasdaq 100 futures down 1.32% and the Hang Seng index more than 2% lower.
- The CoinDesk DeFi index slumped 5.6% while the CoinDesk 5 fell 2.5%.

Bitcoin  slid by the most in two weeks, losing as much as 2.9% since midnight UTC to below $82,000 after mixed earnings reports from Tesla  and Meta Platforms  revived doubts over AI spending and sent equities lower in Asia.
Chinese stocks entered a bear market, Hong Kong’s Hang Seng index fell more 3%, South Korea’s Kospi lost 3.5% and Japan’s Nikkei 225 slipped 2.7%.
Nasdaq 100 index futures dropped 1.32% and S&P 500 futures 0.66%.
Altcoins fell even harder than bitcoin, with the CoinDesk 80 (CD80) recently down 3.2% compared with 2.5% for the CoinDesk 5 (CD5).
